# Reference screens

These pages and screenshots are test scaffolding: three small synthetic screens, each with a
`<button id="b1">`, and 1x1 placeholder PNGs. `design-loop calibrate` and `design-loop ab-distiller`
read every `<name>.html` here together with the `<name>.png` beside it.

Real Stitch outputs replace them at the first live run: drop the generated HTML and screenshot for a
few representative screens into this folder (same basename for the pair) before calibrating.
